unit.why: A short quoted anecdote: R. Elimelech's soul ascends, he is shown the altar he built in the heavenly Temple, he asks a question and receives an answer about the messiah.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a sequence of quoted eschatological passages; the anecdote stands on its own within this division.

stories.summary_en: During an ascent of the soul, R. Elimelech is shown that his holiness built the altar of the heavenly Temple, and he is told the messiah will come once the Holy of Holies is likewise completed, through Torah study for its own sake and yihudim.
